project_specification.project_name: nullius — feature 17 (klines ingest: 1m/1h/1d REST backfill + websocket tail)
project_specification.addition_summary: Implement the klines stream class (app_spec.xml feature 17): the system ingests 1m, 1h and 1d klines from a REST backfill plus a websocket tail, persisting each candle into the append-only staging area retained forever. The module mirrors the landed ingest streams (funding, aggTrades) — a frozen row type, a content-hashed record, an append-only store under staging/klines, and one worker owning the klines stream class — and adds the two properties §4.1's row assigns this stream and no sibling has: a 1m/1h/1d interval dimension, and a REST backfill that fills a historical range alongside the live websocket tail.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace (packages/ingest member, import nullius_ingest) / pytest (ruff + mypy conventions)
existing_context.test_baseline: ingest suite under packages/ingest/tests/, stdlib-only modules plus pyarrow where the schema layer is exercised
existing_context.conventions: snake_case modules, frozen dataclasses for value types, docstrings that cite app_spec.xml feature numbers and docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md §4.1/§4.2, stdlib-only row/record/store/worker layers, injected fetch and injected clock (no REST/WS client and no wall-clock read in checked code, §12/§15), prices and quantities kept verbatim in the venue's own string spelling, instants exact on the epoch lattice (integer microseconds, no float, no timestamp() round trip), @register only in the package __init__ (never a submodule), degrade-don't-break composition. Tests assert on observed behaviour with long narrative docstrings explaining the "why".

feature.description: System constructs a frozen KlineRow for one 1m, 1h or 1d candle with snake_case fields open_time, close_time, trade_count, high_price, low_price and volume kept verbatim in the venue's own string spelling and the open and close instants kept as timezone-aware datetimes on the epoch lattice

System refuses a malformed kline payload in parse_klines, raising a parse error message before any sequence is consumed so a rate-limit body, a truncated frame or a wrong-interval candle never lands in the log as a candle that happened

System persists each kline flush or backfill page as a content-hashed KlineRecord into an append-only KlineStore under staging/klines, retained forever with no retention window, appending at current + 1 into feature 28's staging area so a candle's bytes are frozen the moment the next batch lands and no candle is ever dropped by a retention window

System tails live klines one flush per cycle as the KlineWorker for the klines stream class, using an injected fetch and reporting a quiet cycle as zero rows rather than a failure, with a failed flush becoming that stream's per-stream StreamFailure with an error message and a traceback while every other stream keeps ingesting

System backfills historical 1m, 1h and 1d klines for a symbol over an injected REST fetch, paging across a requested inclusive range and appending each page into the store with the returned range verified against the requested one so a short page raises a not-filled error with an error message naming the covered range and leaves the backfill open rather than silently claiming coverage

System registers the klines worker so importing the module composes it into the ingest supervisor as the klines stream's worker, with register_kline_worker wiring an injected fetch and an unconfigured worker reporting that stream's own failure rather than failing to compose

System passes an end-to-end test in which klines parse and persist into the append-only store, a restarted store resumes from the last persisted sequence with no duplicate rows, a REST backfill covers a requested range, and the websocket tail appends a live flush alongside the backfilled history

project_specification.integration_points: New module packages/ingest/src/nullius_ingest/klines.py owning the klines stream class (StreamClass.KLINES, already declared) Adds the klines worker to the ingest supervisor through the WorkerRegistry (packages/ingest/src/nullius_ingest/registry.py), registered from the package __init__ like every other stream module Writes into feature 28's append-only staging area (packages/ingest/src/nullius_ingest/staging.py) under staging/klines Covered by packages/ingest/tests/test_klines.py
project_specification.constraints: Must not modify existing stream modules, the registry, staging, the supervisor, or any shared file (src/app/middleware.py, src/app/settings.py, migrations/**, alembic/**) The klines store is retained forever with no retention window, matching §4.1's "Klines 1m/1h/1d | REST backfill + WS | continuous | forever" row — there is deliberately no prune, unlike the L2 book-diff stream Klines are not compressed: §4.1 marks only aggTrades "compressed", so the klines store writes plain envelopes like funding and exchangeInfo Prices, sizes and volumes are kept verbatim in the venue's own string spelling; instants are exact on the epoch lattice (integer microseconds, no float, no timestamp() round trip) The REST fetch and the websocket fetch are injected — the member ships no exchange client, so auth, rate limits and pagination stay the deployment's business and the module stays stdlib-only The clock is injected; §12 keeps wall-clock reads out of checked code The interval set is restricted to 1m, 1h and 1d; a candle of any other interval is refused rather than persisted Follow the existing docstring discipline: cite app_spec.xml feature 17 and docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md §4.1/§4.2 All existing ingest tests must stay green

implementation_steps.phase: Add the frozen KlineRow value type (interval restricted to 1m/1h/1d, OHLCV kept verbatim, open/close instants exact on the epoch lattice, trade count an integer) and parse_klines, which refuses a malformed payload before any sequence is consumed Add the content-hashed KlineRecord and the append-only KlineStore under staging/klines, retained forever with no retention window, appending at current + 1 into feature 28's staging area Add the KlineWorker that tails live klines one flush per cycle over an injected fetch, reporting a quiet cycle as zero rows Add the REST backfill that pages historical 1m/1h/1d klines for a symbol over an injected fetch and appends each page with the returned range verified against the requested one Register the klines worker from the package __init__ so importing the module composes it into the ingest supervisor, with register_kline_worker wiring an injected fetch

Add end-to-end tests asserting klines parse, persist into the append-only store, resume after a restart with no duplicate rows, a REST backfill covers a requested range, and the websocket tail appends a live flush alongside the backfilled history

project_specification.success_criteria: Feature 17 implemented: 1m/1h/1d klines ingest from REST backfill plus a websocket tail, persisted into the staging area retained forever The klines worker composes into the ingest supervisor as the klines stream's worker, and a failed flush is that stream's per-stream failure A malformed payload or a wrong-interval candle is refused before any sequence is consumed A REST backfill verifies the returned range against the requested one and leaves the backfill open on a short page All existing ingest tests still green; new klines tests green
